To avoid the pitfalls of previous sites (notably Reddit), I believe we need to have a fundamental shift in the way this site is run. One of the biggest problems with Reddit is the prevalence of mod abuse, since they have so much power there. I think to avoid persistent problems such as this, we need to establish some standard to which moderators would be held. I don't want an overall administrator to act as a judge, either, as obviously this system can be corrupted almost as easily. We need a clear-cut, easily understandable and comprehensive document outlining acceptable behavior. Note that I am not saying this to try to limit the exchange of ideas or information, but to improve.

Things I think a constitution should include:

  • We should have some written guarantee of the original creator's vision for what the site should be.

  • I think subverses should be required to create clear rules defining what posts are and are not acceptable. This will make it clear if communities are being over-moderated.

Any other ideas are welcome. What're your guys' thoughts? Would something like this be useful, or even realistic?
